name: Decision Tick - Open
description: An unanswered decision with somewhere to write the answer down. Deliberately not a checkbox: a step is done or it isn't, but a decision has a CONTENT, and recording only that D3 is 'answered' would strand the actual answer in whichever meeting produced it. That is not hypothetical — D1 has been open since the 2026-07-02 discovery precisely because its answer was never written anywhere durable, so a control that recorded only a flag would repeat the fault it exists to fix.
